name: Cthulhu's Son Is A Scene Kid?!
source:
Juniper, a disabled & depressed transgender woman, meets a new guy at the CD shop, and the two of them fall in love.  However, it turns out he’s the son of Cthulhu!  Will their love prevail?

[From [url=https://norbez.itch.io/cthulhus-son-is-a-scene-kid]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
朱妮珀是一名有身心障礙、飽受憂鬱困擾的跨性別女性。她在唱片店認識了一個男生，兩人墜入愛河。可誰想到，他竟是克蘇魯的兒子！他們的愛能戰勝這一切嗎？

［摘自[url=https://norbez.itch.io/cthulhus-son-is-a-scene-kid]itch.io[/url]］
